name: 8 Out of 10 Cats
description: A weekly, topical panel show based around a huge series of opinion poll surveys carried out around Britain.

videos.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Deal or No Deal
videos.overview: The 8 Out of 10 Cats team - Jimmy Carr, Jon Richardson and Sean Lock - hijack an episode of Deal or No Deal.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2013
videos.overview:
The topical comedy panel show returns for a cracking Christmas special that includes the star families from Gogglebox who provide a running commentary review throughout this edition.

Stand-up comic and presenter Jimmy Carr is at the helm to oversee the disputes and deliberations on the festive topics that set the great British public's chins wagging.

Comedians Jon Richardson and Sean Lock head up the teams for this year's Christmas capers and are joined by Holly Willoughby, Henning Wehn, Alan Davies and Roisin Conaty. Nick Helm and Joe Wilkinson make guest appearances.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2014
videos.overview: Guests Andrew Flintoff, Ricky Wilson and Roisin Conaty join team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson to discuss and dissect a selection of the topical events that have set the British public's chins wagging in the run-up to Christmas, and there's also an appearance from The X Factor's Stevi Ritchie. Host Jimmy Carr oversees the disputes and deliberations.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2015
videos.overview: Team captain Sean Lock is joined by Peter Andre and Seann Walsh to take on his opposite number Jon Richardson, who is ably supported by Roisin Conaty and Joe Lycett. A whole host of familiar faces from the worlds of comedy and entertainment also join in as the panellists cast their eyes over some of the most memorable stories of the year. As well as the usual banter, host Jimmy Carr introduces a selection of classic Christmas games alongside some brand new ones

videos.title: End of Year Special 2015
videos.overview: Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock discuss some of the larger-than-life personalities that have hit the headlines in 2015. Jon and Sean are joined by famous faces from the entertainment world, and there are also silly games and surprises as the guests look back at some of the funniest stories of the year

videos.title: Best Bits
videos.overview: A special compilation episode featuring some of the best and most memorable moments from the latest series.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview:
Presenter and stand-up comic Jimmy Carr takes the centre chair while team captains Sean Lock and Jason Manford are joined by panellists from the world of comedy, entertainment and showbiz. This edition's guests include Claudia Winkleman, Jamelia, Shappi Khorsandi and Charlie Clements.

Each team thrashes out the topics of the week by examining surveys, opinion polls and statistics, discussing all that is silly and serious. Potential subjects could include showbiz gossip, world politics and even the weather. Can the team captains reach the same conclusions as the public? And most importantly, who will give the funniest answers?

videos.title: World Cup Special
videos.overview:
Jimmy Carr referees 45 minutes of end-to-end comedy featuring team captains Sean Lock and Jason Manford.

Guests making up the final teams are Peter Shilton, Helen Chamberlain, Jack Whitehall and Paddy McGuinness. The two sides will go head-to-head in a banter-filled battle of World Cup-themed surveys, polls and statistics.

Who will win? Who will lose? Who will have to take an early bath?

videos.title: Big Brother Special
videos.overview:
The new series kicks off with a Big Brother Special, featuring a countdown of the nation's favourite Big Brother moments and a wealth of ex-housemates from across the past 10 years.

Charlie Brooker, Jarred Christmas, Brian Belo and this year's Big Brother winner, Josie Gibson are on the panel, and they're joined by a host of other favourite Big Brother housemates including Aisleyne, Makosi and John James.

The show aims to be a fitting tribute to the iconic programme, as it's finally put to rest.

videos.title: Christmas Special
videos.overview:
Jimmy Carr hosts a Christmas edition of Channel 4's hit comedy panel show.

Featuring special guests Jack Dee, Lorraine Kelly, Josie Long and Britain's favourite pantomime Dame, Christopher Biggins, the teams are led by captains Sean Lock and Jason Manford.

Together they dispute and deliberate all things festive - from the best things about Christmas Day to the worst person to spend Christmas with. A mixture of surveys, statistics and opinion polls reveal what the nation thinks but do our celebrities agree?
